cohort: 700 children from the Copenhagen Prospective Studies on Asthma in Childhood2010 (COPSAC2010) birth cohort
finding: Cesarean section was associated with distinct early gut colonization patterns in infants, but these differences normalized by one year of age and did not affect airway microbiota.
mod_finding: Delivery by cesarean section was associated with early colonization patterns of the neonatal gut but not of the airways.
